verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents an official CLI that automates installation, configuration, connection (starting sessions) and removal, including silent, non-interactive parameters suited to scripted or agent-driven use. That fully answers the story as written. Its scope is mostly deployment and session launch, and nothing shows agent-oriented ergonomics. missing for 10: machine-readable (e.g. JSON) CLI output, CLI coverage of account and session-management operations (which sit in the separate REST API), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI or agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
To ensure the process runs silently without showing any messages or prompts, add the --silent option
You can start a session using CLI parameters. This is useful for automation or if you're integrating AnyDesk with other systems.
